text: 近日，我会对上市公司上海卓然工程技术股份有限公司（简称*ST卓然）涉嫌定期报告等财务数据存在虚假记载作出行政处罚事先告知。
text_en: Recently, the CSRC issued a prior notice of administrative penalty against listed company Shanghai Zhuoran Engineering Technology Co., Ltd. (referred to as *ST Zhuoran) on suspicion of false records in periodic reports and other financial data.
